runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 22:58 public-web sweep across 14 actually searched source families. Ovečkárna seasonal CZ/SK customer-support brigade was reverified on the direct employer page and promoted to jobs-data.json: IČO/DPP, October 2026-January 2027, Mon-Fri 08:00-12:00, email support, simple order administration, CZ/SK customer line, no experience required, training and explicit work-from-anywhere wording; Prace.cz confirms 160 CZK/h. locationEligibility=remote-ok. A newly surfaced TELOMAR e-shop support brigade pays 170-250 CZK/h but requires a two-week combined onboarding in Jinočany and thereafter combines home office with office work, so it is reject-distance. LinkedIn public inventory again surfaced SupportYourApp fluent-English support. Upwork produced multiple WordPress/e-commerce/VA results, but visible candidates were rejected for strong English, low effective rate, senior/development scope or high competition. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Support channel mix score
developmentChanges.reason: Extract whether customer-support work is primarily e-mail, chat, phone, video or in-person and rank the interaction burden separately from language requirements. This distinguishes calm e-mail/order administration such as Ovečkárna from call-heavy or sales-heavy support roles that look identical under a generic customer-care label.

developmentChanges.title: Mandatory training travel cost ledger
developmentChanges.reason: Record mandatory onboarding/training location, number of days, travel/accommodation cost and whether that time is paid. Use recurring distant attendance as a hard locality reject and one-off travel as application-ROI cost, preventing misleading remote labels such as roles that first require multi-day training far from Bratislava.
